subject_name: Aircraft Wiring Practices (Electrical wiring and Interface system)
topic: Definition of shaft axis, axis rotation, and plane of rotation tip path plane, blade pitch, rotor thrust, relative air flow, coning angle, limit of RPM
syllabus_extract: Definition of shaft axis, axis rotation, and plane of rotation tip path plane, blade pitch, rotor thrust, relative air flow, coning angle, limit of RPM.
specific_objectives: 12.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to understand various terminology associated with helicopters.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of rotor terminology diagrams; Instructor supervision on diagram labeling
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the rotor system?
Can you list three components of the rotor assembly?
Why is understanding rotor terminology important for maintenance?

development.content:
Shaft axis definition
Axis rotation direction
Plane of rotation
Tip path plane characteristics
Blade pitch definition

Rotor thrust generation
Relative air flow concepts
Coning angle explanation
Limit of RPM parameters
Interaction of thrust and airflow

Summary of rotor terminology
Application of terms in context
Clarification of complex concepts
Review of shaft and pitch
Final Q&A session

summary_questions: Define the tip path plane and its relationship to the rotor hub.
Explain how blade pitch affects rotor thrust generation.
What factors determine the limit of RPM for a specific rotor system?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the components to be covered in LP 03 (rotor mast, swash plate, torque link) and how they relate to the rotor terminology defined in this lesson.

pft_rows.syllabus: Components of rotor mast, control system, swash plate, torque link, drag damper, droop restrainer, clutch mechanism, rotor brake, feathering sleeve etc.
